title: Organization Sedan
summary: The Organization Sedans are the most common vehicle of choice for the Organization, being used for transportation, surveillance and espionage. These black cars are commonly driven by Suits to escort their superiors to and from missions, or to spy on enemy Seekers from afar.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Black sedans are frequently used by the Suits all over the globe.

A grey sedan was used to transport DeFoe and Grier prior to their return to Prague as they followed the Huntik team in their quest to find Jodis Lore's notes. [The Casterwill Client]

A white sedan was used to personally transport Wilder to the Road of Alchemists and, later, to take Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit back to Organization Central. It was destroyed when Lok summoned Powerbonded Baselaird inside it, blowing it apart and sending its driver flying. [Chasing Void]

sections.heading: Design
sections.wikitext: The cars consist of a conventional four-door sedan body with a fixed roof and a separate trunk compartment. The exterior design is characterized by a low-profile silhouette and blacked out windows, giving it an unremarkable civilian appearance that allows them to blend in inconspicuously with their surroundings and assist the Organization in spying on enemies.

full_text:
The Organization Sedans are the most common vehicle of choice for the Organization, being used for transportation, surveillance and espionage. These black cars are commonly driven by Suits to escort their superiors to and from missions, or to spy on enemy Seekers from afar.

History

Black sedans are frequently used by the Suits all over the globe.

A grey sedan was used to transport DeFoe and Grier prior to their return to Prague as they followed the Huntik team in their quest to find Jodis Lore's notes. [The Casterwill Client]

A white sedan was used to personally transport Wilder to the Road of Alchemists and, later, to take Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit back to Organization Central. It was destroyed when Lok summoned Powerbonded Baselaird inside it, blowing it apart and sending its driver flying. [Chasing Void]

Design

The cars consist of a conventional four-door sedan body with a fixed roof and a separate trunk compartment. The exterior design is characterized by a low-profile silhouette and blacked out windows, giving it an unremarkable civilian appearance that allows them to blend in inconspicuously with their surroundings and assist the Organization in spying on enemies.

Variants

• Black sedan – The standard and most frequently seen variant, used by Organization agents all over the globe.
• Grey sedan - A grey sedan was used DeFoe and Grier prior to their journey to Prague in pursuit of the Huntik team. [The Casterwill Client]
• White sedan – A unique white variant was used by Wilder and his team in Prague. The car was destroyed when Lok Lambert summoned Powerbonded Baselaird from inside the vehicle. [Chasing Void]

Gallery

Image caption: A black sedan on the Ndego Bridge

Image caption: Metagolem picks up a sedan

Trivia

• The black sedans are all based on the Chrysler 300c Touring models.
